$comment: Source of truth for the /ink/ flight. `src` is relative to the art repo root. Order here is the order you fly through. After editing, run tools/plates/build_plates.py. An entry whose file is not in the art repo yet is skipped with a warning.

plates.title: Lucky
plates.note: Model sheet. Five views, and the ringed tail is the only striped part of him.

plates.title: Scratchboard
plates.note: White cut out of solid black, and two red marks.

plates.title: Troya
plates.note: Model sheet. Dark face, white gloves, a tail that keeps going.

plates.title: Three views
plates.note: Front, startled, and the back of her head.

plates.title: Pin-up
plates.note: Off-model on purpose: solid black body, one red square.

plates.title: Red block
plates.note: Scratchboard fur. The red is an object, never the light.

plates.title: Wide
plates.note: Her stare across a whole spread, one red stroke at the edge.

plates.title: Both eyes
plates.note: The seal dot bottom right arrived unprompted.

plates.title: One eye
plates.note: Torn paper edge, red blot. The purest line in the set.

plates.title: The bowl
plates.note: Eyes in the black above, fork and bowl on bone paper below.

plates.title: Fork, bowl, red
plates.note: The heaviest engraving texture of the ink tests.

plates.title: Light shaft
plates.note: A diagonal of light and one long fork shadow.

plates.title: Red iris
plates.note: Louder than an accent. Kept as a reference, not a page.

plates.title: Portrait study
plates.note: The same engraving line, pointed at a person.

plates.title: By the sea
plates.note: Rocks, water, a few birds. The line holds outdoors too.

plates.title: Doorway
plates.note: Near-black frame, one shaft of light, a small cat inside it.

plates.title: Light wedge
plates.note: Flat dark wall, a hard wedge of bone light, one red dot.

plates.title: Lamp
plates.note: The red accent as a deliberate object on the nightstand.

plates.title: Her best likeness
plates.note: Dark face, off-centre mouth mark, white gloves.

plates.title: The last kibble
plates.note: Chapter one's gesture: his paw over the bowl.

plates.title: Paw in hand
plates.note: A white paw in a hand, a face watching from the shadow above.

plates.title: Pressed together
plates.note: Warm wedge on the wall, grey-blue bedding.

plates.title: The ledge
plates.note: Troya upright, Lucky loafed, red specks on the wall.

plates.title: The watch
plates.note: The pair on a sofa at night. The lazy one is the one awake.

plates.title: Night palette
plates.note: The same pair in teal, with drawn panel borders.

plates.title: Asleep
plates.note: Closed-eye curves, pink toe beans. The house is quiet.
